subject: Vulnerability management evidence & SBOM — Pioneer Financial RFP
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pioneer-fin.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: security@pioneer-fin.com
Date: 2026-09-10T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Initial request — VM evidence for RFP

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Pioneer is moving your RFP to formal evaluation and the security team has asked for a consolidated evidence package for vulnerability management. Specifically they want:
- SAST/DAST coverage (tools, cadence, owners)
- Patch SLAs and exception process
- Recent pen test summary and remediation status
- SBOM and third-party component inventory

Can you provide a single packet (attachments or a shared Drive) and a short timeline for when we can expect delivery? We're targeting an internal review on 2026-09-17.

Thanks,

Elena Morris
Head of Vendor Risk
Pioneer Financial
elena.morris@pioneer-fin.com
Attachment: None
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pioneer-fin.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — VM evidence for RFP

Elena,

Appreciate the summary and the timeline. We'll assemble a consolidated package that covers everything on your list. High level plan:
1) SBOM export + dependency provenance (CSV).
2) Pen test executive summary + remediation matrix (PDF).
3) SAST/DAST tooling overview and scan cadence (doc).
4) Patch SLA table and escalation flow (spreadsheet).

Can you confirm whether Pioneer needs code-level SARs for open-source components or a high-level SBOM suffices for the first pass? We'll aim to deliver the packet by EOD 2026-09-14 and can extend if you need deeper artifacts.

Regards,

Rohan Mehta
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0132
Attachment: vm-evidence-template.xlsx (stub)
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pioneer-fin.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: security@pioneer-fin.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — VM evidence for RFP

Rohan —

High-level SBOM is fine for now; if we progress we'll ask for deeper provenance. Please include any mitigations in place for critical CVEs tied to our likely runtime profiles (multi-tenant hosted inference). Also include your standard pen test attestation date and whether tests were performed on production-like infra.

Elena

P.S. Please send files as attachments or Drive links; we prefer consolidated downloads for internal circulation.
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pioneer-fin.com>, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — VM evidence for RFP

Elena / Rohan,

Attached you'll find the initial packet. Highlights:
- SBOM (Pioneer_SBOM_20260910.csv): exports from our dependency inventory; includes direct and transitive components and license classification.
- Pen test executive summary (penetration_summary_redwood_20260914.pdf): independent third-party test performed 2026-08-29 against our staging cluster (production-like config). All findings have assigned owners; critical/high results have mitigations deployed for the runtime path used by hosted API.
- VM summary checklist (vm-summary-checklist_20260915.xlsx): includes SAST/DAST tools (Snyk for SCA, Semgrep + custom rules for SAST, OWASP ZAP for DAST), scan cadence, false-positive handling, and patch SLA table (see sheet 'Patch SLA').

Notes on patch SLAs:
- Critical: 72 hours to mitigation plan + 30 days to patch or compensating control.
- High: 7 days to mitigation plan + 90 days to patch.
- Exceptions: Formal exception request routed through Security with JIRA ticket; exec approval required for >90-day windows.

Let us know if you want deeper SARs or raw scan exports and we'll add them to a secure Drive link.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachments: Pioneer_SBOM_20260910.csv (attachment stub), penetration_summary_redwood_20260914.pdf (attachment stub), vm-summary-checklist_20260915.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@pioneer-fin.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — VM evidence for RFP

Elena —

Following up to confirm you received the packet Monica shared. Quick clarifications requested by your team in prior RFPs — added below:

1) Pen test scope: included in summary; tests targeted staging with production‑like datasets and runtime flags. Full test report is restricted but available under NDA; we can provision a review session with our vendor.
2) SBOM cadence: automated weekly inventory with monthly attestations; we can provide historical snapshots on request.
3) Live patching / maintenance windows: dedicated maintenance windows are scheduled for Dedicated customers; hosted tier uses rolling updates with canary and quick rollback support.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-minute call the week of 2026-09-20 to walk through any outstanding questions and confirm whether you need raw scan exports or SAR artifacts?

If Pioneer confirms call availability, I'll send a calendar invite and include the vendor pen-test lead.

Best,

Rohan Mehta
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
